params.description: Optional parameter to filter wireless LAN controller by its cloud ID. This filter uses multiple exact matches.

params.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 31 days from today.

params.name: t1
params.description: The end of the timespan for the data. t1 can be a maximum of 31 days after t0.

params.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameters t0 and t1. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 31 days. The default is 7 days.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 1000.

params.description: A token used by the server to indicate the start of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those.
